podcast.body: This 1994 recording is suggested as a point of reference in discussions of music featuring common keyboard figures, particularly in the context of the Katy Perry/Flame lawsuit over keyboard ostinatos. "maybe both of them should take a listen to this 1994 recording by the Art of Noise called Moments in Love."
